properties.Description: Bethel is a major regional hub for the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta. It has a state-owned airport that serves as a cargo and passenger distribution center for over 50 villages. There is no road connection to the contiguous state highway system; however, an ice road is often established on the Kuskokwim River during winter months. The Port of Bethel is the northernmost medium-draft port in the U.S. and is a vital distinct hub for barge services.

Cordova is accessible by plane or boat only. It is served by the Merle K. (Mudhole) Smith Airport which supports daily jet service. The community is a regular stop for the Alaska Marine Highway System (State Ferry), connecting it to Valdez and Whittier. The comprehensive harbor and dock facilities support a large commercial fishing fleet. While there is a local road system (Copper River Highway), it does not connect to the statewide road network.
